limitations: Code IDs identify exact WGSL strings within this run; they are not cross-run identifiers.
Layout IDs are object identities, not a proof of structural incompatibility.
Layout descriptors are captured at creation; equal descriptors do not validate resource data or all runtime behavior.
Shader normalization is an experimental syntactic comparison, not proof that pipeline layouts or bindings are interchangeable.
Modules created before the measured sample can be missing from the captured shader source.
